author: Magnace7
body:
Hi, I'm magnace. I am new here but have been really enjoying Avicus so far! I just have a "few" things to mention :)

1. Tabs and Lists
- Make ranks/badges visible in tab, not just chat
- Organise the tab player/team listing. Make the tab have sections for each team  then alphabetical inside those sections
- Make your own name more visible in tab (Bold/Italic/the top of the tab)

2. Kits/Armour and Maps
- Change up the starter kits on DTM a bit, at the moment its the same iron/stone sword, diamond pick, infinity bow, 3 gapples, food and some stacks of blocks maybe take away the gapples in some maps or change the sword type
- Maybe some maps have a regular bow or just a power bow instead of infinity. Also don't use the enchanting thing so much as it can get really overpowering. Use different blocks for the monument e.g. end-stone as the block and use a stone pickaxe to have to break it.
- Different armour sets at the start as its mostly the same
- Also for DTM I'm not sure if there already is something like this but maybe after a kill streak of 3 you get a better pick axe then you can mine the monument with that.  Just a wider variety of how to break the monument

3. Sounds
- To change the sound of your team winning/getting the objective to the other team of doing so e.g. When the game ends it should be a different sound to when you get only ONE of the objectives 
- Make the sound of the other team winning lower and more of a loosing sound than a winning sound

These are just suggestions, thank you for getting this far.

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
These ideas are all very OCN-like. Considering most if not all of them are in OCN at the moment.

We don't want to become a second OCN, we want to be the first Avicus.

replies.author: AbusiveUser
replies.body:
1. Tabs and Lists
The new tab is coming with the Atlas release (from what I could see in the beta testing of the Atlas), so don't worry about that. Just to clarify I don't know if they are going to add the Ranks in the tab (wait for an admin answer for this)

3. Sounds
You can change your sounds in the Lobby clicking in the Cosmetic Shop --> Sounds, just you need to pay for those.

What SnowSX3 said is true, we don't want a second OCN here, we're Avicus my lord.
